root_prerequisites: Actual separate source-read and host-read/native-query authority
Entire proposed capture source and exact diff for any reused source
Fresh native/interpreter/bootstrap/configuration input pins and observed settings; no inherited key assertion
Exact absent new output/cwd/cache observation by root, not from this preparation
Distinct installed help/option acceptance before lookup phase

commands.stdin: actual /dev/null character-device identity, bound by root before use
commands.source_body_timeout_or_size_limit: Any separately bound finite limit must preserve a partial failure rather than truncate a purported whole body.

required: actual original product request and all real yielded session/poll/final returns
pre-spawn ATTEMPT with exact argv/cwd/environment/deadline/input key
actual native handle/pid/session when one exists
actual native exit distinct from wrapper outcome
owned-session settlement, interventions and remaining member census
full source/tool/configuration input keys before and after
complete nonself payload/empty-directory manifest after genuine closure
native_record.no_handle: UNKNOWN/UNCLOSED, no final raw hashes or native seal
native_record.escaped_writer_scope: Not proved closed by owned-session evidence; no OS-hermetic or continuous-open claim

query_interpretation.default_resolution: Candidate effective lookup only, not proof of actual TeX consumption; receive corresponding --all and installed search semantics.
query_interpretation.all_resolution: Capture every original line and returned source body; do not replace it with a sorted set or only the first basename.
query_interpretation.required_missing: HOLD even when native exit 1 is a syntactically permitted query outcome; no guessed path or empty successful dependency.
query_interpretation.stderr: Retain all raw bytes; diagnostics/unsupported options are received before interpreting output as dependency data.
query_interpretation.config_empty: Empty variable output is actual query data only, not a filesystem absence observation.
query_interpretation.expanded_variable: -expand-path=$TEXMF must be passed as one literal argv item; never expand it in the caller shell.

body_capture.scope: Only an actual separately approved returned path set and its finite alias/ancestor chain, never broad recursion.
required: Preserve each query label, exact raw result line and original spelling
Resolve/pin each full symlink/ancestor chain as separate metadata roles, without enumerating siblings
Require a finite regular-file referent for a source/body; reject device/socket/directory as body
Capture full body bytes in an exclusive new workspace file; no line/grep-only capture
Bind lexical path, resolved path, read handle identity and full before/after integer stat metadata plus byte hash/size
Record actual copy/read operation and later real byte comparison to the selected referent, with separate raw cmp streams
Retain every shadow body and every source/config/macro byte span supporting each derived edge
Preserve all failed/partial bytes without final-success seal when unsettled
body_capture.limitation: Finite before/after and read-handle observations are not continuous path-race/OS-open tracing. A body hash with no retained full body cannot support later source semantics.
